name: Wikipedia · Alan Turing
intro: Welcome. We will find Alan Turing on Wikipedia and look through his article.

steps.title: Search for Alan Turing
steps.say: I move to Wikipedia's search field and type Alan Turing. The matching article appears below the field.

steps.title: Open the Alan Turing article
steps.say: I click the result in the search suggestions and check the article heading.

steps.title: Scroll through the article
steps.say: I scroll down through the article at a readable pace.

steps.title: Close the walkthrough window
steps.say: I close the rehearsal window after reading the article.

description: Search Wikipedia for Alan Turing, open the article, scroll and close the rehearsal window.
